extensions.name: AR
extensions.desc: Places your 3D scene on real tables and floors through WebXR augmented reality on Android phones and AR headsets. Tap to anchor the world, then play on top of the real room.

extensions.name: Behavior Trees
extensions.desc: Structured enemy and NPC brains: sequences, selectors, conditions, actions, waits, repeats, inverters and parallel nodes with a per-entity blackboard. Trees tick every frame and keep running actions across frames.

extensions.name: Crowd Simulation
extensions.desc: Flocking crowds, herds and swarms. Agents keep their distance, move together, flow toward goals and push around obstacles, scaling to thousands with a spatial grid.

extensions.name: Day/Night Cycle
extensions.desc: A full sun and moon cycle. 3D scenes move the sun, recolor the sky, fog and light; 2D scenes get dusk and night grading, stars, and glowing lights on anything tagged "light".

extensions.name: Destructible World
extensions.desc: Break things apart. Shatter any entity into physical debris, blast craters into solid tilemaps, and push nearby bodies away from explosions. Anything tagged "breakable" caught in a blast shatters too.

extensions.name: Dialogue AI
extensions.desc: A polished dialogue box with typewriter text, speaker names and branching choices, plus live AI conversations: give an NPC a personality and players can talk to it in their own words. AI replies use Puter, which is free and needs no API key.

extensions.name: AI Director
extensions.desc: Paces your game like a horror or horde director. Tracks player stress, cycles calm, build-up, peak and relief phases, and spawns enemies off screen at the right moments so fights never feel flat or overwhelming.

extensions.name: Gamepad
extensions.desc: Xbox, PlayStation and Switch controllers. Sticks and buttons drive your keyboard controls automatically, with rumble and per-button reads for custom mappings.

extensions.name: Hand Tracking
extensions.desc: Tracks both hands in VR with all 25 joints per hand. Read fingertip positions and detect pinches to grab, point and press without controllers.

extensions.name: Kokoro Voice
extensions.desc: Natural AI voices from the open Kokoro-82M model, generated on the player's device with no server or key. Make any NPC speak any line, with 3D panning from the speaker. Falls back to the system voice while the model downloads.

extensions.name: Motion Blur
extensions.desc: Camera motion blur that streaks along the direction the view is moving, plus per-object trails for fast movers. Scales with frame rate so it looks the same at 60 and 144 Hz.

extensions.name: Multiplayer
extensions.desc: Online multiplayer over peer-to-peer WebRTC with no server to run. Host a room, share the 5-letter code, and friends join from any browser. Includes messages, shared state, join and leave events and automatic entity replication with smoothing.

extensions.name: NavMesh & Pathfinding
extensions.desc: Builds a walkable navigation grid from your static bodies and solid tiles, then finds smooth A* paths around them. Send any entity to a point or another entity and it steers there, re-planning when the world changes.

extensions.name: Particle FX
extensions.desc: GPU-friendly particle systems for 2D and 3D: continuous emitters and one-shot bursts with gravity, drag, size and color over life, additive glow and presets for fire, smoke, sparks, magic, explosions and dust.

extensions.name: PBR
extensions.desc: Physically based rendering: image-based sky lighting, ACES filmic tone mapping and per-object metalness, roughness and glow. Metals reflect the sky and colors stay natural in bright scenes.

extensions.name: Post Processing
extensions.desc: Screen effects for 2D and 3D: bloom, color grading, vignette, film grain, scanlines and chromatic fringe. Change any of them live from scripts for hit flashes, slow-mo or flashbacks.

extensions.name: Advanced Shadows
extensions.desc: Soft variance shadows at up to 4096px that follow the camera, shadow-casting point lights and per-object control. Crisp up close, soft at the edges, no acne.

extensions.name: World Streaming
extensions.desc: Keeps huge levels fast by putting far-away entities to sleep. Anything outside the streaming radius stops rendering, colliding and running physics until the camera comes back. Tag an entity "always" to keep it awake.

extensions.name: Procedural Terrain
extensions.desc: Seeded terrain generation. 2D fills a tilemap with hills, caves, grass, dirt and stone. 3D builds a smooth height-mapped landscape with sand, grass, rock and snow, and keeps every body standing on it.

extensions.name: Touch
extensions.desc: On-screen joystick and buttons for phones and tablets. They press the same keys your game already uses, so mobile ports work with no script changes.

extensions.name: Voice Chat
extensions.desc: Live voice between players in a Multiplayer room, with push-to-talk, mute, and optional proximity so voices fade with distance between replicated players.

extensions.name: Volumetrics
extensions.desc: Volumetric light scattering: god rays stream around anything that blocks the sun, plus exponential fog that thickens with distance. Rendered on the GPU with a radial scattering pass.

extensions.name: VR
extensions.desc: Play 3D scenes in a headset through WebXR. PC VR headsets run through their OpenXR runtime (SteamVR, Meta Link, Windows Mixed Reality) and standalone headsets run it in their browser. Controllers drive WASD, jump and turning.

extensions.name: Advanced Water
extensions.desc: Tag any entity "water" to turn it into animated water. 3D gets layered waves, Fresnel reflections, sun glints and foam; 2D gets a rolling surface and bubbles. Bodies inside float, drift and slow down.

extensions.name: Weather System
extensions.desc: Rain, snow, storms with lightning and thunder, and rolling fog, with wind and smooth transitions between states. Works in 2D and 3D and can change on a timer or from scripts.
